decisions.resolution: Nonempty ids-only properties array; no invented per-link required/settings fields.

decisions.exact_excerpt: Attaching a property makes it apply to a type, and this is where you decide whether it is required for that type.
decisions.resolution: Overview disagrees with attach operation: ids-only operation-specific contract wins.

decisions.exact_excerpt: The value to set for the property. Its type depends on the property type: a string for text, URL, email, and file fields; a UUID string, or a list of UUIDs when `is_multi` is `true`, for relations and options; a `YYYY-MM-DD` string for dates; a number for decimals; and a boolean for booleans.
decisions.resolution: ApiParam object label conflicts with explicit scalar/array field prose. Preserve union; null not documented and not accepted.

decisions.exact_excerpt: Retrieve the property value(s) for a specific work item property. Returns a single value for non-multi properties, or a list for multi-value properties.
decisions.resolution: Identical GET/get source response semantics: canonical get, list source alias.

decisions.exact_excerpt: Retrieve the property value(s) for a specific work item property. Returns a single value for non-multi properties, or a list for multi-value properties.
decisions.resolution: Native object or array is preserved without pagination or value-id path.

decisions.exact_excerpt: Work item type ID. If you omit it, the response contains the default type's schema when work item types are enabled, or only the standard fields otherwise.
decisions.resolution: V1 optional --id becomes type_id query; v2 requires --id path. No hidden fetch.

decisions.exact_excerpt: Names must be unique within the payload, case-insensitively.
decisions.resolution: Reject case-insensitive duplicate option names; no undocumented whitespace trimming.

decisions.exact_excerpt: Any option currently on the context that you do not reference by `id` is removed, along with the values recorded through it.
decisions.resolution: Context updates require --yes because option replacement removes recorded values. Project property update documents recorded values staying unchanged; do not infer the same destructive behavior.
